movie.title: Sniper: No Nation
movie.overview: Brandon Beckett and Agent Zero lead a rescue mission in Costa Verde when their friends are taken hostage.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a covert operation in Costa Verde turns into an international scandal, disavowed ace sniper Brandon Beckett and Agent Zero team up with his legendary father to launch an off-the-books rescue mission for captured allies.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Following an explosive operation in Costa Verde, the U.S. government disavows the Global Response & Intelligence Team (G.R.I.T.) and brands its operatives as terrorists. Forced underground, master sniper Brandon Beckett and Agent Zero discover their rebel allies have been captured by brutal mercenaries. To save their imprisoned friends from public execution, Brandon unites with his legendary father, Thomas Beckett, to launch an impossible rescue mission. Operating without backup or official support, they must battle overwhelming odds to pull off their most dangerous fight yet.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In the wake of a high-stakes covert operation in Costa Verde, evidence surfacing from the fallout causes an international scandal. To appease foreign political leaders, the U.S. government completely disavows the Global Response & Intelligence Team (G.R.I.T.), scrubbing their existence and branding operatives Brandon Beckett and Agent Zero as rogue terrorists. Going AWOL and forced into hiding, Beckett soon learns that their allies in the Phoenix Rebellion have been decimated by the Iron Legion, a mercenary force hired by Costa Verde's ruthless president. With several key rebellion members captured and scheduled for public execution, Beckett realizes he cannot stand idly by while his friends suffer. Needing all the assistance he can get, Brandon reunites with his legendary father, veteran sniper Thomas Beckett, alongside Zero and surviving rebels. Stripped of their flag, official backup, and military clearance, the team plans a high-stakes infiltration to break their comrades out of enemy territory. Facing heavily armored mercenaries and tight deadlines, they fight through intense gun battles and close-quarters combat. As the rescue unfolds, Brandon must contend with complex political crossfire and relentless enemy forces. Ultimately, the team proves their deadly resolve in an explosive showdown, setting the stage for an ongoing battle for survival and justice.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: When a covert operation in Costa Verde blows open into a global scandal, the U.S. government disavows its elite Global Response & Intelligence Team (G.R.I.T.) and brands its members as rogue enemies of the state. Disowned and on the run, ace sniper Master Gunnery Sergeant Brandon Beckett and his trusted partner Agent Zero go underground to avoid capture. However, exile is short-lived when they learn that Costa Verde's tyrannical government has deployed a ruthless mercenary group known as the Iron Legion to crush their remaining freedom-fighter allies and capture key operatives for public execution. Unable to rely on military backing, Brandon turns to his legendary father, veteran sniper Thomas Beckett, to execute a daring off-the-books rescue operation to save their friends before time runs out.

story_structure.climax: The team launches a tactical rescue strike against heavy mercenary opposition, engaging in intense close-quarters combat and sniper warfare to break into the prison compound before the scheduled execution takes place.
story_structure.conflict: With their unit disavowed and allies decimated by a ruthless mercenary force known as the Iron Legion, Brandon discovers his captured teammates face imminent public execution under Costa Verde's authoritarian regime.
story_structure.resolution: With the captives rescued and the immediate threat neutralized, Brandon and his comrades navigate the political fallout of becoming stateless operatives, setting the stage for their ongoing battle against global conspiracies.
story_structure.introduction: Following a covert operation in Costa Verde that spiraled into an international crisis, ace sniper Brandon Beckett and his team are disavowed by the U.S. government and branded as terrorists, forcing them to operate off the grid.
story_structure.risingAction: Operating without official state backing or backup, Brandon joins forces with Agent Zero, his legendary father Thomas Beckett, and local rebels to plan an unsanctioned, high-stakes infiltration mission into enemy-controlled territory.
